name: hcapp_logClientErrors
description: Stores a session-level client error log in HC.ClientErrorLog. No auth: @accessToken is accepted for API consistency but never checked, and device registration is not required, so logs from de-registered devices (e.g. repeated approveLogin token failures) are still captured. One row per call = one session's accumulated exception log, stamped with the app version/build that WROTE it (@hcVersion/@buildNumber, sent by clients from 3.0.13); when both are NULL the device's CURRENT HC.Device.Version/BuildNumber are used as a best-effort fallback.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID written as-is to ClientErrorLog.DeviceId (no FK). Also used for the version fallback lookup.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Accepted for API consistency; intentionally not validated. Dead input.

parameters.name: errorLog
parameters.description: Full session error log text (entries separated by newlines and '===' delimiters). Written as-is; NULL violates the NOT NULL column and surfaces as the CATCH envelope.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: App version that wrote the log, e.g. '3.0.12' (from 3.0.13). When NULL together with buildNumber, falls back to HC.Device.Version.

parameters.name: buildNumber
parameters.description: Build number that wrote the log, e.g. '1327'. Same fallback as hcVersion (HC.Device.BuildNumber).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always present. success=1, errorCode NULL, errorType NULL on success; success=0, 1992, 19 on an unhandled error.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 on unhandled DB error.

rowsets.description: Only on the CATCH path. The HC.ErrorLog row has userId NULL (no auth) and HcVersion = @hcVersion + '+' + @buildNumber when both were sent, else HC6.DeviceHcVersion(@deviceId).

sideEffects: SELECT HC.Device.Version / BuildNumber when both version parameters are NULL (line 53-56)
INSERT HC.ClientErrorLog (DeviceId, ErrorLog, AppVersion, BuildNumber); Id and LoggedAt from table defaults (lines 58-63)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog with userId NULL on an unhandled error (after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken and @errorLog (lines 3-5) have no SQL default; omitting one is an unlogged empty 500 before the body runs.
A NULL @errorLog fails the NOT NULL constraint on ClientErrorLog.ErrorLog and is reported as the generic 1992 unhandled error rather than a validation error.
Accepted in the signature, never read. By design (header lines 13-16); cannot be removed without an API contract change.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
Auth is intentionally skipped for this SP. Callers must not assume that @accessToken is validated.
1.1.0 (2026-09-09): @hcVersion / @buildNumber added (optional, additive) and stored in the new AppVersion / BuildNumber columns.
